versions.changelog: Names SEOmatic and the approve-first rule; exact tool and task names.

Initial release of seomatic-traffic-drop

- Diagnose causes of organic traffic drops using real Search Console data.
- Distinguish seasonality from actual losses and identify affected pages and queries.
- Check indexing issues, competitor SERP features, and potential technical or content changes.
- Prioritize and suggest fixes, with staging options if eligible.
- Clear instructions for connecting Search Console and using each diagnostic tool.
